Recorded answers of __ID__.

For each file in this folder, write:

- the address it was fetched from, and the day and minute (UTC);
- the licence it is under and the credit the provider asks for, as in
  ../../manifest.toml;
- what was cut from it (stations, days) and how;
- for a file damaged by hand, what was done to which entry.

Nothing in this folder is made up unless this file says so, entry by entry.
